summary: Base of the script-visible wrapper objects: an embedded value/container at +0x0C plus a shared release-hook pointer and hook argument at +0x30/+0x34, used by the generic refcount-release path.

fields.name: maybe_releaseHookArg

summary: Small refcounted holder for an inline array of Squirrel values (SQObjectPtr) used by the script system: GC-chain linked, with an optional element-array holder at +0x1C and inline storage at +0x2C. Size 52: the batch's 48 counts only 4-byte fields, but the inline SQObjectPtr at +0x2C is 8 bytes.
evidence: Ctor 0x0018BD88/0x0018BE68 install vtable 0x007589F4 and std_ConstructArray(self+0x2C, 0x001BF784, 8, 1); dtor 0x0018BF48 unlinks from sharedState+0x48 and releases the holder at +0x1C; GetItem 0x0018BBB0 reads element base holder+0x38.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Ctor and dtor store 0x007589F4 at +0; the dtor finishes by storing the base vtable 0x0075A728.

fields.name: refCount
fields.evidence: Dtor tests (f_4 & 0x80000000), the Squirrel GC mark flag, before unlinking from the shared-state chain.

fields.name: weakRef
fields.evidence: Dtor checks it and resets target+0xC tag to 0x01000001 and target+0x10 to 0 (SQWeakRef::_obj), then clears this pointer.

fields.name: sharedState

fields.name: maybe_valueArray

summary: Squirrel hash table (SQTable proper): a GC-chain-linked refcounted object with a bucket array of 0x14-byte SQHash nodes, open chaining, a free-list cursor and a delegate pointer.
evidence: Sq_HashTable_Init (0x006009E8) installs vtable 0x0077F770, zeroes +4/+8/+0xC/+0x10/+0x18, stores the owner at +0x14 and links into owner+0x48; AllocNodes (0x005FFD88) fills +0x20/+0x24/+0x1C; Set/Get walk nodes at +0x20 with stride 0x14; Destroy (0x00600A54) removes from sharedState+0x48 and frees the array at +0x20.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Init stores 0x0077F770; derived ctors overwrite it; Destroy finishes with the base vtable 0x0075A728.

fields.name: refCount
fields.evidence: Init clears it; Destroy tests (f_4 & 0x80000000) (GC mark flag) before unlinking from the chain.

fields.name: weakRef
fields.evidence: Init clears it; Destroy writes null tag 0x01000001 at (f_8)+0xC and 0 at +0x10 (SQWeakRef::_obj).

fields.name: gcNext
fields.evidence: Cleared by Init; part of the SQCollectable chain (_next at +0xC, _prev at +0x10).

fields.name: gcPrev
fields.evidence: Cleared by Init; SQCollectable chain back-link.

fields.name: sharedState
fields.evidence: Init stores the owner here and links via 0x00245C1C(owner+0x48, self); Destroy unlinks via 0x00245C40(self->f_14 + 0x48, self).

fields.name: delegate
fields.evidence: Init clears it; Destroy calls the delegate setter 0x001BC750(self,0) and Clone copies table->f_18 into the clone's +0x18.

fields.name: firstFreeNode
fields.evidence: AllocNodes sets it to the last node (base + count*0x14 - 0x14); Set recycles nodes by walking it down towards the bucket array.

fields.name: nodes
fields.evidence: AllocNodes stores the 0x14-byte bucket array here; Get/Set index it as f_20 + (hash & (f_24-1))*0x14; Destroy frees it with count*0x14.

fields.name: nodeCapacity
fields.evidence: AllocNodes stores the (power-of-two) node count; Init rounds requested capacity up to >=4; Set masks the hash with it - 1.

fields.name: usedNodes
fields.evidence: Init clears it; Set increments it per inserted entry; Resize decides growth/shrink from it.

summary: Small string-keyed hash map used by the script registry: a power-of-two bucket array of chain heads, an entry count and 0x20-byte string nodes.
evidence: Script_HashTable_GetOrInsert (0x00248490) hashes the key, indexes *(u32**)(*table + (hash & table[1]-1)*4), walks node+0x10, doubles table[1] on growth and increments table[2]; node layout next +0x10, length +0x14, string +0x1C.

fields.name: buckets
fields.evidence: Chain-head array: result = *(u32**)(*table + bucket*4); reallocated with func_0014B350(size<<3) and zeroed with func_00116AE0(..., table[1]<<2).

fields.name: bucketCount
fields.evidence: Masked as (hash & table[1]-1); doubled when entryCount+1 exceeds it; the rehash allocates table[1]<<3 bytes.

fields.name: entryCount
fields.evidence: Incremented after a successful insert (table[2]); triggers the grow when bucketCount < count+1.

summary: Contaminated class: four of its five functions are Squirrel VM API entry points (sq_get slot, remove key, register natives) and the fifth is an unrelated Container_Value destructor; the only consistent pair (+0x30/+0x34) is the VM's _top/_stackbase cursor pair.
evidence: Script_Table_RemoveKey (0x006BC838) tests (vm+0x30)-(vm+0x34) < 2 = 'not enough params in the stack'; the same pair is used by every Script_Vm_Get*/CheckParams* accessor as _top/_stackbase. 0x006E75FC actually belongs to Container_Value (vtable 0x00781004), and GetSlot/RemoveKey/RegisterNatives are the sq_get/sq_remove/sq_register_natives API.

fields.name: stackTop
fields.evidence: vm+0x30 minus vm+0x34 gives the number of parameters (0x006BC838, 0x006BA7F4, 0x006BA6B4); SetTop/Resume write it and every stack accessor reads it.

fields.name: stackBase

summary: Not an object class: the three 'methods' are embedded SQRegFunction descriptor arrays in .text (Actor2DMove*, ActorActionSeq*, ActorAim* native bindings) whose decompilation runs into data and halts; no heap layout exists.

summary: Shared Squirrel VM state (SQSharedState, 0xB8 bytes): metamethod vectors/map, system string and type vectors, string table, RefTable, registry/consts/constructor objects, GC chain, root VM thread and the ten default delegates. NOTE: struct_db merged this object with the separate 0xA8-byte SQVM, whose +0x30/+0x34 are _top/_stackbase.
evidence: Script_Vm_Create (0x006BC454) allocates exactly 0xB8 bytes, calls Script_Vm_InitTables (0x00247C68) and Script_Vm_RegisterDefaultDelegates (0x00245FD0), then allocates a separate 0xA8-byte SQVM (Sq_InitStackFrame 0x005BB44C) and stores it as an OT_THREAD at +0x4C. InitTables initialises the RefTable (+0x18..+0x2C) and ReleaseTables (0x00247D94) frees every vector/table with the sizes shown here. The base 'Sq_HashTable' recorded by struct_db is not a real base: it comes from the two SQTable objects the ctor creates.

summary: Squirrel compiler function state (SQFuncState, 0xF4-byte allocation): owns the local-variable/target vectors, the function/parameter/outer-value/instruction/localvar/lineinfo arrays, the literals and strings tables, the parent link, the error handler and the child-state list; used by the Script_SqCompiler_* parser.

Script_Function_Destroy (0x001BE7AC) frees 0x14-stride SQLocalVarInfo/SQOuterVar vectors, 8-byte SQObjectPtr vectors and int vectors with exactly the sizes used here, and recursively destroys the 0xF4-byte child states at +0xE0. base=Sq_HashTable is the struct_db guess from the two tables the ctor creates; SQFuncState has no such base.

summary: Squirrel compiler (SQCompiler): current token, the SQFuncState being built, the source name, the SQLexer state at +0x10, line-info/raise-error flags, a stack of expression targets, the error-message pointer, the setjmp/longjmp buffer and the VM pointer.
evidence: Compile (0x00188C9C) creates the root funcstate at self+4, sets self[0x17]=1/self[0x18]=0, calls setjmp(self+0x1E) and reports errors through sharedState+0xA4; Factor (0x00187780) compares *self with the token constants (0x7B '{', 0x7D '}', 0x3B ';', 0x103 identifier, 0x11D) and passes self+0x10 to Sq_LexerReadToken; the field at +0x1F8 is the SQVM (vm+0x8C = SQSharedState, vm+0xA4 = compiler error handler). base=Script_Compiler is the struct_db inference from the compiler class-name family; SQCompiler in the reference source has no base.

fields.name: token
fields.evidence: *self is compared with every token constant (0x3D '=', 0x28 '(', 0x7B '{', 0x103 identifier, 0x11D function) and updated from Sq_LexerReadToken by every parser method.

fields.name: funcState
fields.evidence: self+4 is the SQFuncState passed to Script_FuncState_* helpers and CreateString; Compile (0x00188C9C) stores the root state there - SQCompiler::_fs.

fields.name: sourceNameTag
fields.evidence: Type tag of the source-name SQObjectPtr; Compile copies this tag/value pair onto funcState+0x90/+0x94.

fields.name: sourceNameValue
fields.evidence: Value word of the source-name string object (SQCompiler::_sourcename).

fields.name: previousToken
fields.evidence: Compared with '\n' (10), 0 (EOB), '}' 0x7D and ';' 0x3B in the end-of-statement logic of Compile (0x00188C9C) - SQLexer::_prevtoken.

fields.name: currentLine
fields.evidence: Passed as the line argument to Script_SqFuncState_AddLineInfos (0x001BD1A4) by Compile and Statement (self[7]) - SQLexer::_currentline.

fields.name: lastTokenLine
fields.evidence: Read as self[8] next to currentLine for the line-op decision - SQLexer::_lasttokenline.

fields.name: stringValue
fields.evidence: Passed as the string argument to Script_FuncState_CreateString (0x001BD318) in Factor and Expect with the length from +0x48 - SQLexer::_svalue.

fields.name: integerValue
fields.evidence: Used as the integer literal value in Factor (0x00187780), including unary minus - SQLexer::_nvalue.

fields.name: floatValue
fields.evidence: Used as the float literal value (VFP path) in Factor - SQLexer::_fvalue.

fields.name: longStringLength
fields.evidence: self[0x12] is passed as the string length to Script_FuncState_CreateString and used as (len-1) in Expect - SQLexer::_longstr.size().

fields.name: lineInfoEnabled
fields.evidence: Byte passed as the lineop flag to Script_SqFuncState_AddLineInfos (0x001BD1A4) in Compile and Statement - SQCompiler::_lineinfo.

fields.name: raiseError
fields.evidence: Tested before invoking the shared-state compiler error handler in Compile (0x00188C9C) - SQCompiler::_raiseerror.

fields.name: debugLine
fields.evidence: Set to 1 at the start of Compile (self[0x17]) and later copied from the lexer line - SQCompiler::_debugline.

fields.name: debugOp
fields.evidence: Cleared at the start of Compile (self[0x18]) - SQCompiler::_debugop.

fields.name: expressionStack
fields.evidence: Vector base for 8-byte entries pushed by Factor (token type word at +0, target -1 at +4) and popped after postfix parsing.

fields.name: expressionStackCount
fields.evidence: Vector size incremented/decremented when Factor pushes/pops an expression state.

fields.name: expressionStackCapacity
fields.evidence: Vector capacity; Factor reallocates with func_0014CE14(ptr, cap<<3, newcap<<3).

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.evidence: Pointer to the formatted compiler error text: passed to sharedState->compilerErrorHandler(vm, msg) and to Script_Registry_LinkObject as the error name in Compile (0x00188C9C).

fields.name: errorJmp
fields.evidence: setjmp target: func_0012625C(self+0x1E) at Compile start and longjmp func_00126290(self+0x1E, 1) in every Error path.

fields.name: vm
fields.evidence: self[0x7E] is the SQVM: vm+0x8C is the SQSharedState (used for funcstate, source name and registry) and vm+0xA4 is the compiler error handler.

summary: Mis-attributed class: its only function 0x001BC808 is SQFuncState::BuildProto, which builds an SQFunctionProto from the function state, so these offsets are SQFuncState members (the same object as Script_Function), not members of the produced prototype.
evidence: Script_SqCompiler_Compile (0x00188C9C) calls 0x001BC808 with self[1] = the SQFuncState; BuildProto reads 0x14-stride vectors at +0x6C/+0x70 and +0x54/+0x58, 8-byte vectors at +0x3C/+0x40 and +0x48/+0x4C, the literals table value at +0x7C and the literal count at +0x98 - exactly the SQFuncState layout named in Script_Function.
